title: My little AI browser game now has 4-player multiplayer. This side quest got out of hand 😂
author: Zestyclose-Use9011
selftext:
I’m a graphic designer. This started with me asking ChatGPT 6 to make a little open world browser game inspired by the stuff I grew up playing.

The first playable version took 37 minutes and 1 prompt. That was the base game, not everything you see now. I’ve kept building on it since.

Then I added a time machine. Now you can get three mates into the same room 😂

For the original prompt I described the jobs and what the player could do, rather than just asking for a nice city. Taxi jobs, paper runs, rewards, car damage. That gave me actual things to try out.

I’m choosing the ideas and testing it. AI is writing the code. I’m not going to pretend this is a studio-made GTA replacement, it’s my slightly ridiculous browser game.

Sharing my own game here. No download or account needed: [https://play.city.klipzi.com](https://play.city.klipzi.com)

PS. I will be hanging out personally in KlipZi City - you will know it's me in there - I'll be named "KlipZi" LOL. Hop in my Delorean and I will take you for a ride. Or steal it, anything is possible :-P
